title: Thumble game controller asset attachment v1
description: Bounded native attachment input for an already installed manifest-generated controller. Carries PNG bytes and opaque manifest asset IDs, never local paths, URLs, native asset IDs, bindings, or arbitrary profile edits. Authority and MCP revision/idempotency fields wrap this object separately. Rust additionally validates the manifest, exact asset coverage, decoded image bounds, and destination control mappings before applying any change.

manifestJSON.description: Original game-controller manifest v1 as JSON text. Must pass plan_game_controller validation. Rust enforces a 256 KiB UTF-8 byte limit; JSON Schema maxLength alone counts characters.

images.description: Exactly one image per declared manifest asset ID. Duplicate, missing, or undeclared IDs fail Rust validation. Combined decoded PNG file bytes are bounded to 4 MiB and combined image pixels to 16,777,216.

profileID.description: Authoritative destination profile UUID. Use the installed UUID returned by profile import/list, which may differ from the planner's source profileID.

pngBase64.description: Canonical standard Base64 including required padding, without a data-URL prefix or whitespace. Rust enforces zero padding bits and fully decodes a static PNG with CRC checks, at most 2,500,000 file bytes and 2048 pixels on either axis. Animated PNGs are rejected.
